info.title: Nursing home fines and harm citations by county: CMS penalties, actual-harm, immediate-jeopardy and abuse citations: data API
info.summary: Static, read-only JSON and CSV files. No key, no sign-up. CORS open.
info.description:
Nursing home fines and harm citations by county: CMS penalties, actual-harm, immediate-jeopardy and abuse citations: For every US county with a Medicare- or Medicaid-certified nursing home, every state and territory, and the US: how many certified nursing homes and beds there are, how many times the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) fined them in the last three years and for how many dollars, how often and for how many days it denied payment, and how many health citations inspectors wrote at the actual-harm level or worse (scope and severity G to L), at the immediate-jeopardy level (J to L) and under the abuse, neglect and exploitation tags (F600 to F610), plus the share of rated homes with one star overall. Built each month from the four CMS Provider Data Catalog files behind Care Compare. Counts only: no facility names, addresses or certification numbers, and no resident data (CMS publishes none).

Probative is a marketing firm, not a law firm; not legal advice. Every JSON response starts with a "meta" object holding the credit line, citation, DOI and license (CC BY 4.0).
